summary: EXPRESSbakēd Phase 2 Sub-feature C (Pricing Engine Admin) verified end-to-end. 13/13 backend pytest cases PASS in test_express_pricing_admin.py — aggregated GET returns all 5 parcel rules + vehicles + movers for CI (XOF/CFA) and LR (LRD/L$), unsupported country XX returns 404, unauth returns 401. PATCH /express/pricing/CI/bike echoes new values AND propagates to live /api/express/quote/parcel breakdown (base_fare=2000 flowed through to customer quote). Unknown fields silently dropped; empty payload returns 400; unknown vehicle returns 404. Movers PATCH works. Audit logs record express.pricing.* actions. All CI/LR parcel rules and CI movers restored to seeded defaults via the same admin API in the session teardown fixture (verified post-run: CI bike base_fare=1500 min_fare=1500 price_per_km=150 price_per_min=40; LR bike base_fare=500 price_per_km=60; CI movers packing_per_item=300 labour_per_mover=4000). Frontend admin UI at /admin/modules/express/pricing: pricing tab active (data-testid module-tab-pricing highlighted), country switcher (CI+LR), 5 rows with 11 numeric inputs + Active checkbox + Save each, per-row dirty state (only edited row's Save enables, others stay disabled), save clears the row and refreshes; switching to LR reloads with rate=500 and L$ currency; movers card renders 16 inputs (15 numeric + Active) with a single Save-movers button; Mart module workspace nav does NOT show Pricing tab; deep link /admin/modules/mart/pricing correctly redirects to /admin/modules/mart via the guard useEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: module_routes.py PricingRulePatch/MoversPricingPatch use Optional[float] with default None and the handler strips None via model_dump(exclude_none=True) then re-filters against PARCEL_RULE_FIELDS/MOVERS_RULE_FIELDS whitelist — solid double-defence pattern. Unknown fields are naturally dropped by pydantic (extra='ignore' is default) and the whitelist enforces intent. Empty result → HTTP 400 with clear message. Good.
GET /express/pricing uses supported = countries.find_one({code, active:true}) then 404 if inactive — correct.
audit is called via _audit with the exact changes dict, so audit logs contain both what was changed AND to what values. Good for compliance.

ModulePricing.jsx guard useEffect uses navigate(..., {replace:true}) so back-button doesn't loop back to /pricing — correct. Guard also fires when code param changes, not just on mount — safe against nav to another module.

ModulePricing dirty state is keyed by rowKey('parcel:'+vehicle_code) so each row tracks changes independently. Save button correctly disables based on Object.keys(pending).length. Nice single-source-of-truth pattern.

NumberCell coerces empty string to null (rather than 0) — this is important so that clearing a cell + Save sends null rather than a zeroing 0. However, the admin API accepts null (exclude_none=True drops it), so a user who clears a cell and hits Save effectively makes no change to that field. That's an acceptable UX (clearing = 'don't change'), just document it. Not a bug.
Frontend uses adminApi (with auth interceptor) — no missing token issues observed.
Movers card renders 16 inputs (15 numeric fields per MOVERS_FIELDS + 1 Active checkbox); spec said 15 numeric — that matches.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_express_pricing_admin.py (NEW - 13 tests: 4 GET, 6 PATCH parcel + live-quote propagation, 3 PATCH movers, 1 audit)
seed_data_creation: None. The fixture snapshot_and_restore GETs both CI+LR pricing at session start and PATCHes it back at teardown. Post-run values verified via curl: CI bike base_fare=1500, LR bike base_fare=500, CI movers packing_per_item=300 labour_per_mover=4000 — all match seeded defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_express_pricing_admin.py is safe to re-run — session-scoped snapshot/restore fixture guarantees the DB is left in seeded state. If a run is aborted between snapshot and restore (SIGKILL etc.), reseeding express_pricing_rules is trivial via the /admin/modules/express/pricing PATCH endpoints using SEED_CI_BIKE / SEED_LR_BIKE constants at the top of the file. The live-quote propagation test uses flat pickup_lat/pickup_lng/drop_lat/drop_lng (not nested pickup:{lat,lng}) — /api/express/quote/parcel schema is flat.
rca_of_the_issue: No production bugs. One transient test-authoring issue was self-fixed: initial quote payload used nested pickup:{lat,lng} format; corrected to flat pickup_lat/pickup_lng/drop_lat/drop_lng which matches the current pydantic schema at /api/express/quote/parcel.
